findings.description: F003 does not explicitly require successful or typed-skip adapter EvidenceRefs to carry EvidenceRef.surface_class, while F002 makes missing surface_class structurally ineligible for satisfying any surface group.
findings.recommendation: Pin the surface_class emitted by each adapter and assert it for both available and unavailable outputs: cli_agent for the CLI source, agent_mcp_tool for the MCP source, and the intended contract-check surface explicitly.

findings.description: F002 requires availability, consumer_family, surface_class, and data_provenance for evidence to satisfy readiness, but the plan does not define how existing human-surface screenshot or recording producers will populate those new fields.
findings.recommendation: Add a normalization or metadata-enrichment step for existing human evidence sources, with tests proving a real screenshot EvidenceRef can satisfy the new checker without rebuilding the adapters.

findings.description: The typed-skip shape is described, but validation is not fully pinned against malformed unavailable evidence such as unavailable plus real provenance, missing degraded_mode, missing reason note, or missing evidence_class.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit schema and harness tests rejecting invalid typed-skip combinations and asserting note, data_source, consumer_family, degraded_mode, evidence_class, type, data_provenance, availability, and surface_class.

findings.description: The pinned token map still has an ambiguity: it claims a total deterministic map over eight journey surface tokens but writes ios/android as a combined token, which leaves the accepted token domain unclear.
findings.recommendation: Pin every accepted journey.surfaces token individually, including whether ios and android are separate accepted tokens, and test that each token maps to exactly one surface_class while unknown tokens fail closed.

findings.description: The checker returns a single status even though journey-level aggregation can create multiple independent per-surface and conjunctive-group failures, so mixed missing_provenance, seeded, and mismatch cases are not deterministic.
findings.recommendation: Pin either a per-surface result shape or a strict precedence order for aggregate status selection, including how missing groups with alternative evidence classes are reported.
